🏌️ Bamboo / Wooden / Plastic Golf Tees – 12 Options for Every Swing

*100 pcs per pack | 42mm / 54mm / 70mm / 83mm | Choose your material & color*

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✨ Why Choose Our Golf Tees?

✅ High‑Quality Material
Crafted from premium bamboo, wood, or durable plastic – each tee is built to last and provide consistent performance.

✅ 4 Essential Sizes
42mm (1.65"), 54mm (2.1"), 70mm (2.8"), 83mm (3.3") – perfect for irons, fairway woods, drivers, and practice mats.

✅ 100 Pcs Value Pack
Each pack contains 100 tees – great for individual golfers, small groups, or keeping a fresh supply in your bag.

✅ Multiple Style Choices

  • Natural Bamboo / Wood – eco‑friendly, biodegradable

  • Colored Wooden – bright & easy to spot on the course

  • Plastic Tee – extra durable for heavy use

  • Limited Height – fixed low height for consistent iron practice

  • Cup‑Top Tee – wider top for better ball stability

✅ Ideal for Practice Mat & Driving Range
Works perfectly on mats, turf, or grass – helps you train realistically and improve your swing.

✅ Origin : Mainland China

🔹 Colored Wooden Tees – Bright, fun colors make them easy to find after your drive.
🔹 Plastic Tee (70mm) – Extremely durable, resists breaking on mats or hard ground.
🔹 Limited Height (70mm) – Fixed low height, ideal for practicing irons & hybrids without adjusting tee depth.
🔹 Cup‑Top Tee (70mm) – Concave top holds the ball more securely, reduces side spin for straighter shots.
